# Pedagogical notebooks on PINNs (work in progress)

## Context
Personal training and pedagogical documentation. Step by step implementation of PINNs in 
PyTorch, applied to the same equations as the ones in [TreeGrass2D](treegrass2d.qmd) (woody and herbaceous biomass dynamics in fire prone savanna), but in 1D for clarity.

## Content
- Notebook 1 : computation of the partial derivatives with PyTorch (autograd) on simple examples, step by step progression
- Notebook 2 : implementation of PINNs in 1D for a system of PDE representing the dynamics of forest-savanna biomass

## Stack
Python - PyTorch - Jupyter - Markdown

## Statut
🔧 Work in progress : repository to be made public once finished.
